artworks.title: Envy Driven from the Temple of the Muses
artworks.artist: Master of the Die after Baldassare Peruzzi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with numerous figures and classical architecture. The central figure is a muscular, bearded man holding a large club. Surrounding him are various other figures in dynamic poses, with classical drapery. The background features columns, arches, and a cloudy sky. The engraving is detailed, capturing the drama typical of mythological narratives.

artworks.title: Naval Battle
artworks.artist: Master of the Die after Giulio Romano
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a naval battle scene featuring ancient ships engaged in combat. The detailed linework illustrates several ornate ships with armored figures on board, some armed with spears and shields, while others are seen rowing. The ships are adorned with intricate carvings and designs, including images of mythical figures and patterns. The sea is depicted with swirling waves, adding intensity to the scene. The overall composition highlights historical motifs and demonstrates a high level of craftsmanship in its portrayal of an ancient maritime conflict.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Scipio
artworks.description: The image shows a triumphal procession. A group of soldiers and horses are marching through an archway carrying objects and banners. The figures are dressed in Roman military attire. Spears and standards rise above the crowd, and an ornate cart is being carried to the side. The drawing features detailed linework to convey texture and form, creating a sense of depth and movement.

artworks.title: Hercules and Cacus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.6 x 15.4 cm (7 11/16 x 6 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a combat scene. The image features a figure on top of a centaur, holding a large bone or club above their head. The centaur seems distressed. The background has diagonal lines hinting at movement. At the bottom, there is a shield with a lion's face and a dagger lying on the ground.

artworks.title: The Holy Family in a Landscape
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 11 cm (5 5/8 × 4 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image contains two figures, a man standing and a woman seated. The man has a bushy beard and curly hair, while the woman has long wavy hair. The man is holding a staff and pointing, while the woman is holding a naked baby. They are surrounded by detailed textures of a rocky ground, grass, trees, a village with stone buildings, mountains, and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: The Crowning with Thorns
artworks.artist: Follower of Master of the Playing Cards
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gothic architectural setting. The drawing includes a central figure surrounded by several other figures. The scene takes place within a structure resembling a medieval or gothic building with arched elements and pillar designs. The figures are depicted in a style typical of late medieval manuscript illustrations, focusing on linear details such as robes and facial expressions. The scene features a checkered floor and architectural elements reminiscent of a palace or grand hall. The figures appear to be interacting, with one central seated figure being approached by others holding sticks or rods. The drawing uses strong outlines and hatching to convey depth and form.

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 32.5 × 23.8 cm (12 13/16 × 9 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features many figures standing closely together. The central figure has shoulder-length hair and a beard, wearing flowing robes. The surrounding individuals wear varied clothing, from armor to civilian attire. Their facial expressions vary from concern to aggression. Some carry staffs or spears. The background includes arches and columns, as well as a rocky landscape. The image is depicted in black and white, highlighting intricate patterns and textures.

artworks.title: The Mount of Calvary
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 36.3 × 25.1 cm (14 5/16 × 9 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The drawing depicts a detailed and chaotic scene centered around a crucifixion, with figures in various poses of anguish, prayer, and indifference. The central figure is on a cross, flanked by two other individuals in similar positions. A group of people and animals are gathered below, some on horseback. The background features buildings and a landscape. The drawing uses precise linework to convey texture and emotion across the scene.

artworks.title: The Apostle Simon
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with their body facing slightly to the right. The individual is holding a book against their chest with one arm, while the other arm rests on a large saw. The person has facial features including a beard and long, wavy hair. They are dressed in a long robe that covers their legs, revealing their bare feet. The background is plain, and the initials "WA H" are inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Man and Woman Embracing
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures, one an older man and the other a younger woman. The man has a full beard and wears a hood. The woman has smooth facial features and neat hair with a hair ornament. She wears an elaborate dress with embroidery and a necklace with a cross pendant. The man has his arm around her shoulder. The background is plain. The style of the image is a sketch or engraving.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of floral and insect motifs. The artwork features symmetrical floral patterns, curling vines, leaves, butterflies, and dragonflies. The composition is divided into sections, with a central medallion and a bordered design with flourishing patterns. The image is rendered in monochrome, emphasizing the detailed style of the motifs.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate design with swirling lines and ornamental shapes forming a dense and decorative pattern. A central symmetrical arrangement resembles botanical elements like stylized flowers and leaves, suggesting a vase or floral bouquet. The border includes winding tendrils and blooms reminiscent of an ornate garden lattice. Two symmetrical mythical figures resembling mermaids or nymphs are present, adding to the fantastical elements of the design. The artwork combines nature-inspired forms with creative abstractions.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image features stylized floral and insect motifs arranged throughout the composition. The largest floral shapes are at the top left and center. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of brown and beige, and dark brown or black ink creating contrast against a light, aged paper background. The patterns fill most of the rectangular space, with swirling floral designs and detailed depictions of insects scattered across the scene.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image displays intricate, swirling lines and shapes forming an abstract composition with symmetrical elements. In the center is a circular motif with a scene resembling a person under two barren trees, similar to a storybook illustration. Surrounding the center are vase-like shapes with spiraling vine-like lines and floral embellishments. In the lower corners are rectangular sections with designs resembling clusters of leaves and flowers, akin to vintage floral patterns on wallpaper or fabric.

artworks.title: Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures in a classical landscape. The image depicts three figures in various poses. The main figure is standing confidently with a staff in one hand. Beside him, there are two figures, one embracing or supporting the other. In the background, there are structures resembling classical buildings or castles. The figures are detailed with intricate linework, emphasizing the contours and musculature of their bodies.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two travelers with animals in a forest setting. The drawing captures a detailed scene within a circle. Two figures in medieval or rustic clothing are shown on a journey. One figure is walking, while the other rides a donkey. They are accompanied by oxen. The forest background is filled with detailed trees and foliage, creating a sense of movement and life. The drawing is realistic and has a historic character.

artworks.title: Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring several figures in an architectural setting. The image includes four figures positioned in front of a structure resembling a small temple or monument with columns and a frieze. The figure on the left wears armor and holds a circular object. The central figure, also in armor, is semi-seated with head bowed. Two nude figures on the right are depicted, one tying a rope around the central figure while the other observes. The background shows dense foliage, suggesting an outdoor setting. The scene conveys a narrative quality with dynamic interaction among the figures. The drawing is done in a classical or renaissance style similar to engravings by artists like Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.6 x 23.5 cm (10 7/8 x 9 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene with a small house and surrounding landscape. The drawing shows a woman in flowing robes sitting outside a wooden structure, accompanied by a small figure. An older figure stands to the right with a staff. In the sky, two cherubic figures are among the clouds. The background includes rocky hills, a winding path, groups of animals, and trees. The drawing is detailed with textural shading and contrast between light and dark, emphasizing the scene's tranquility and beauty.

artworks.title: Hercules Killing the Lion
artworks.description: The image shows a man grappling with a lion. The man is muscular and bearded, while the lion appears fierce. Strong lines and detailing are used to emphasize the figures. The background includes a tree and foliage.

artworks.title: Mutius Scaevola
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a knight and two men inside a tent. The knight wears armor and a plumed helmet, facing two seated men under a richly decorated tent. One man, with a long beard, holds a dagger above a table. A sword is placed centrally, gripped by all figures. In the background, spears with banners stand upright. The drawing is detailed, with textures applied to the folds of clothing, armor, and tent canopy.

artworks.title: Ornament with Grotesque
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative and mythological scene. The design includes a central image of a mythical creature with a humanoid figure riding it in the ocean. Surrounding the central scene are decorative elements such as birds, vines, floral motifs, and shell-like structures. The overall composition is highly stylized with a Baroque or Rococo influence, characterized by elaborate forms. The top center shows a mythical figure playing a wind instrument amongst foliage. The artwork displays symmetry and detailed line work typical of historical decorative arts focusing on ornamentation.

artworks.title: Ornament with Grotesque
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines and symmetrical shapes circling around a central diamond shape with a depiction of a horseman. Scroll-like tendrils, floral motifs, and crescent shapes are interwoven in the abstract composition. Figures resembling crouching primates are at the top corners, and elements resembling arranged weapons or heraldic symbols are at the lower corners. Organic and geometric forms combine to create a rich tapestry of interconnectivity and complexity.

artworks.title: Ornament with Grotesque
artworks.description: The image contains swirling lines and ornamental shapes arranged in a symmetric pattern. In the center, there are two horned figures resembling satyrs with outstretched arms. A scene in an oval frame shows smaller figures carrying circular objects with a cloud above them. The decoration includes ornamental flourishes and detailed motifs.
